channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O que é o Conselho da República? Coordenador de Lula defendeu convocação
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, legal coordinator of Lula's campaign, advocated for the President to convene the Council of the Republic amid the crisis at the STF. The Council, an advisory and deliberative body of the Presidency, brings together ministers, governors, and legislators to discuss matters of national interest.

item.title: Tarcísio, sobre impeachment de Moraes: Órgão que precisa dar resposta é o Senado
item.description: São Paulo Governor and reelection candidate Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated that it is up to the Senate to respond to the crisis at the Supreme Court following speeches by allies who defended the impeachment of Justice Alexandre de Moraes during the September 7th rally. Tarcísio avoided taking a direct stance on the impeachment, pointing to the Senate as the body responsible for addressing the issue.

item.title: Mendonça x Moraes: a decisão que pôs a PF no meio do fogo
item.description: Minister André Mendonça removed the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues and intelligence director Leandro Almada, triggering an institutional crisis among the STF, government and PF before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha defende que Lula convoque órgão que trata de estado de sítio
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, campaign coordinator for Lula, advocated for the convocation of the Council of the Republic to analyze an alleged institutional crisis. He criticized the suspension of the head of the Federal Police by Minister André Mendonça, suggesting President Lula has constitutional basis to activate the collegial body. The Council of the Republic is responsible for advising the president on federal interventions, states of defense and siege.

item.title: Lula foi omisso e Mendonça não teve alternativa, diz Moro sobre troca na PF
item.description: Sergio Moro criticized Luiz Inácio Lula for omission and argued that Supreme Court minister André Mendonça had no alternative but to suspend Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues. Moro supported Mendonça's decision and stressed the need to preserve republican institutions during the ongoing election. He also confirmed signing the impeachment request against Alexandre Moraes to ensure accountability and due defense rights.

item.title: O possível gesto de Lula a Motta às vésperas do primeiro turno
item.description: Before the first round of Paraíba elections, President Lula may support Nabor Wanderley, father of Hugo Motta, in his Senate bid. This gesture aims to strengthen the government's legislative agenda, such as the MP ending the 'blusinhas' tax, and counter the tainted support of Veneziano Vital do Rêgo, linked to investigations involving Cícero Lucena.

item.title: AGU vai recorrer ao STF da decisão de Mendonça sobre Andrei até esta quarta
item.description: The AGU will appeal Minister André Mendonça's decision to remove Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues for 90 days. The federal government argues Mendonça violated the President's exclusive jurisdiction by acting unilaterally. The removal was based on suspicions of illegal monitoring within the agency.

item.title: Como está disputa de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro em Minas Gerais, segundo pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading the electoral race in Minas Gerais in both the first and second rounds, with 44.3% and 48.7% of voting intentions, respectively. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is in second place, with 35.4% in the first round and 42.1% in the second. Despite the lead, approval of Lula's government among Miners is low, with 52% disapproving of his administration.

item.title: Crusoé: Moraes já suspendeu nomeação de diretor da PF
item.description: A Crusoé report points out that Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes had previously suspended the appointment of a PF director in 2020 (Alexandre Ramagem), in a ruling similar to Justice André Mendonça's decision that removed Andrei Rodrigues. The Lula government has criticized Mendonça's ruling, fueling controversy over the Supreme Court's role in Federal Police appointments.

item.title: Por que o Ibovespa está em alta enquanto as outras bolsas caem no resto do mundo?
item.description: The Ibovespa surged, driven by rising oil prices and expectations of political turnover in 2027, with Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in a new poll. The market reacts negatively to public debt growth under Lula's administration, while the stock rally reflects optimism about more fiscally conservative policies.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Lula defende acionar o Conselho da República contra decisão de Mendonça
item.description: Lula's campaign legal coordinator, Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, supports President Lula filing a motion with the Council of the Republic in response to Minister André Mendonça's decision to remove Federal Police Director Andrei Passos Rodrigues. Carvalho labels the decision as politically motivated and urges the government to appeal to the STF before complying with the order.

item.title: Quanto vale o passe do ex-secretário de Nunes na campanha de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign hired Fábio Portela's company, former Communication Secretary under Ricardo Nunes, for R$3.6 million to handle press advisory services. Portela, who led São Paulo City Hall's communication during Nunes' administration, left the position in May to join the presidential campaign. The move involved Rogério Marinho and underscores the emphasis on communication in the final stretch of the race.

item.title: Sindicato defende Andrei e critica “uso político” do Judiciário
item.description: The SinpecPF expressed support for PF Director-General Andrei Rodrigues and Intelligence Director Leandro Almada after their removal ordered by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The union criticized the 'political use' of the Judiciary, claiming the measure may compromise the autonomy of the Federal Police. Mendonça justified the removal as necessary to preserve judicial guarantees.

item.title: “Seguiremos firmes contra os intocáveis”, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) praised STF Minister André Mendonça's decision to remove Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues. The dismissal followed a request by the party, reinforcing anti-corruption efforts.

item.title: Lula indicou, PF afastou: Flávio acusa governo de perseguir adversários
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro criticized President Lula after the dismissal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, questioning the agency's independence and accusing the government of targeting political opponents. He noted that Andrei's appointment was allegedly made at Lula's request but did not acknowledge the removal as justified.

item.title: Como André Mendonça virou o jogo no novo ‘round’ da disputa com Moraes e deixou Lula em silêncio
item.description: André Mendonça leveraged a crisis involving the Federal Police and Andrei Rodrigues's leave to gain ground in the internal STF dispute, increasing pressure on Moraes and silencing Lula. The shift in power dynamics eases the path for immediate institutional response from the court, backed by civil society entities like the OAB.

item.title: Andrei Rodrigues é notificado sobre afastamento da PF
item.description: Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, was notified of the removal ordered by minister André Mendonça. The injunction remains in force despite Gilmar Mendes' request for review, which suspended the trial at the Supreme Court's Second Chamber. The case is controversial, as some justices believe Mendonça stretched the law in accepting the request from the New Party, directly interested in the presidential election.

item.title: Mendonça soube que PF vasculhava sua vida e mudou hábitos
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça changed his habits after discovering the Federal Police were monitoring him through intelligence reports. He now uses a signal-blocking box for phones and plays classical music to hinder eavesdropping, calling it 'institutional espionage' and requesting investigations.

item.title: Miguel Reale: Ou Lula afasta logo comando da PF ou País viverá anomia e liquefação da República
item.description: Miguel Reale warns that President Lula must immediately dismiss the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues and intelligence director Leandro Almada as ordered by the STF, otherwise the Republic will be jeopardized.

item.title: Veja o que os candidatos à Presidência disseram sobre a decisão de Mendonça de afastar cúpula da PF
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça provisionally removed the Federal Police director-general, Andrei Rodrigues, and the Intelligence director, Leandro Almada, suspected of illegally monitoring STF ministers. The decision sparked reactions among presidential candidates, particularly from those opposing President Lula's government.

item.title: Lula chama reunião emergencial após determinação para afastar Andrei
item.description: President Lula called an emergency meeting after Supreme Court minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of Andrei Rodrigues from the Federal Police command. The government considers the decision an intrusion into the presidential power to appoint the PF director-general and is preparing an appeal to the STF. The case involves investigations into possible intelligence monitoring by the Federal Police.

item.title: “Intocáveis”: decisão contra diretor da PF atende pedido do partido de Zema
item.description: Minister André Mendonça decided to remove the Federal Police director, Andrei Rodrigues, following a request by the Partido Novo, which has Romeu Zema as a presidential candidate. The decision was justified to preserve the independence of investigations. Zema, known for mocking STF ministers in videos, used the decision to reinforce his criticism of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Marina e Tebet lideram disputa pelo Senado em SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Futura/100% Cidades poll released on September 8, 2026 shows Marina Silva (Rede) and Simone Tebet (PSB) leading the Senate race in São Paulo with 34.9% and 32.7% of voter intent, respectively. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters from September 2–4, with a 2.4-point margin of error and a cost of R$128,000, registered with the TSE.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro celebra afastamento de Andrei da PF e afirma que corporação voltará a ter ‘autonomia’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated the removal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, stating the agency should regain autonomy to investigate without protecting President Lula. The decision was made by Minister André Mendonça following revelations of messages and reports suggesting clandestine investigations against Supreme Court justices.

item.title: Lewandowski fica de fora de manifesto de aposentados do STF
item.description: Former STF president Ricardo Lewandowski did not sign the manifesto of retired Supreme Court ministers supporting Edson Fachin, claiming he was unreachable while traveling in a remote area. He noted that, even if contacted, he would not have publicly endorsed his former colleague.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas vence no 1º turno em SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey released on September 8, 2026, by Futura/100% Cidades shows that Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads the 2026 state elections in São Paulo in the first round, with 54% of voting intentions against 31.5% for Fernando Haddad (PT). In a potential runoff, the figures rise to 57.1% versus 34.5%.

item.title: Saiba quem é Andrei Rodrigues, ex-segurança de Lula em 2022
item.description: Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, was removed at the request of the STF. He served as security advisor to Lula in 2022 and led key investigations including the Compliance Zero and Sem Desconto operations.

item.title: Moro evita debates e é ironizado ao tentar se associar a Ratinho Jr na TV
item.description: Sergio Moro, leading in polls for Paraná governor, avoids debates and steers clear of criticizing Ratinho Jr, whose government has 80% approval. Ratinho Jr supports Sandro Alex's campaign, leveraging Moro as a key endorsement. Moro's strategy to align with the governor is mocked in the media.

item.title: Na gestão Bolsonaro, Moraes vetou posse de chefe da PF, que responderia a Mendonça
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes blocked Alexandre Ramagem's appointment as head of the Federal Police in 2020, during Bolsonaro's government, citing political interference risks. Now, in 2025, Minister André Mendonça removed Andrei Rodrigues from the same position over illegal surveillance allegations and misuse of a report. The conflict highlights tensions between the two Supreme Court justices and different PF leadership approaches.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 57% e aprovado por 40% em SP, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Futura/100% Cidades released on September 8, 2026, shows that 40.2% of São Paulo voters approve of President Lula's government, while 57.1% disapprove. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters between September 2 and 4, with a margin of error of 2.4 points and a cost of BRL 128,000.

item.title: Lula se reúne com ministros para discutir afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da PF
item.description: President Lula met with ministers to discuss the dismissal of Andrei Rodrigues from the Federal Police, following a decision by Minister André Mendonça. The AGU plans to appeal the dismissal, arguing that the STF decision exceeds presidential authority. The case is linked to the Banco Master scandal and involves high-ranking officials from the STF.

item.title: Virada de Flávio Bolsonaro em pesquisa acende o alerta na campanha de Lula
item.description: A new BTG/Nexus poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro overtaking Lula numerically, cutting a six-point gap from June. Political scientist Elias Tavares highlighted Bolsonaro's gains in the South and among evangelicals, while Lula holds strong support in the Northeast.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que é contra privatização da Petrobras e Embrapa, mas não dos Correios
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos, from the Missão party, stated he opposes privatizing Petrobras and Embrapa, but supports privatizing the postal service and other companies he deems 'useless'.

item.title: Doleiro de Vorcaro complica a vida de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Antonio Carlos Freixo Junior, linked to Daniel Vorcaro, confirmed to the Brazilian Attorney General's Office that he transferred $69 million to the Havengate fund in the US, under investigation for money laundering. The revelation complicates matters for Flávio Bolsonaro, tied to the scandal.

item.title: André Mendonça afasta diretor-geral da PF, Andrei Rodrigues
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues over suspicions of illegal surveillance of government officials. The decision also removes Police Intelligence Director Leandro Almada da Costa and authorizes criminal and administrative investigations.

item.title: Renan Santos reage à decisão de Mendonça sobre Andrei Rodrigues: "Fez bem"
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Missão) praised Minister André Mendonça's decision to remove Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues during an interview on Jovem Pan radio. He described the action as positive, calling it part of an alleged 'institutional war'.

item.title: Mendonça afasta Andrei Rodrigues do comando da PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, and Leandro Almada da Costa, intelligence director, suspected of monitoring his activities at the STF. The unilateral decision also suspends the production of intelligence reports on judges and will be reviewed by the STF's Second Chamber.

item.title: Flávio tem 45% contra 41% de Lula em 2º turno no AP, diz pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data survey in Amapá shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45% against Lula's 41% in a potential runoff, within the margin of error. Both candidates face high rejection rates (49% and 48%), and Lula's government approval is evenly split (49% approve, 49% disapprove).

item.title: Amapá: ex-prefeito pode vencer aliado de Lula e Alcolumbre no 1º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll shows former mayor Antônio Furlan (PSD) leading with 62% of voting intentions in the first round, against 31% for Governor Clécio Luís (União Brasil). Victory may occur in the first round despite support from Lula and Alcolumbre for the governor.

item.title: O terceiro caminho leva ao Centrão (por Paulo Markum)
item.description: The text examines how third-way candidates in Brazil, such as Augusto Cury, rely on alliances with larger parties to remain viable, highlighting the role of Centrão. It proposes semi-presidentialism as a solution but acknowledges the difficulty of constitutional approval given the parliamentary fragility of the Avante party.

item.title: Isenção da taxa das blusinhas vai na contramão do resto do mundo
item.description: Congress approved the elimination of the 'blusinhas tax', benefiting imports of up to 50 dollars. While Brazil relaxes its rules, other countries are tightening, citing unfair competition and fraud.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (8)
item.description: Presidential candidates have a busy schedule with debates, interviews, meetings with supporters and technical visits across states like São Paulo and Brasília. Most carry out campaign activities, while the PL and PT candidates keep a private schedule. The order of presentation rotates alphabetically each day.

item.title: Club Brugge x Aston Villa na Champions League: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Club Brugge and Aston Villa face off on Tuesday, the 8th, at 1:45 PM (Brasília time) at Jan Breydel Stadium in the first round of the Champions League 2026/27 league phase, broadcast on TNT and HBO Max. The Belgian side, led by Hans Vanaken, seeks to leverage home advantage, while Aston Villa, managed by Unai Emery, aims to secure points away from home. The teams renew a recent clash where the English side claimed victories in the previous edition.

item.title: Mendonça determina o afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da direção da PF
item.description: Justice Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues over allegations of illegal surveillance tied to the Banco Master case. The ruling also removes intelligence director Leandro Almada da Costa and suspends intelligence reports targeting judges and prosecutors. The move deepens the institutional crisis at the STF.

item.title: Renan Santos defende reforma ‘profunda’ no STF e diz que Toffoli e Moraes são ‘ilegítimos’
item.description: Renan Santos advocates for deep reforms in the STF, deeming ministers Moraes and Toffoli illegitimate, and proposes privatizing Correios while keeping Petrobras and Embrapa.

item.title: ‘Se o Flávio Bolsonaro for eleito, o Vorcaro não fica na cadeia. Eles vão combinar o que fazer com os R$ 40 bilhões que estão fora do Brasil’, diz Haddad em SP
item.description: Haddad countered Flávio Bolsonaro regarding the Banco Master scandal, stating that Lula's government liquidated the company and arrested suspect Daniel Vorcaro. He claimed the 40 billion reais overseas are managed by shell funds and questioned corruption during Bolsonaro's administration. Haddad also criticized Flávio's linkage between Lula and the STF, emphasizing the president's institutional relations.

item.title: Vídeo: Representantes dos Três Poderes participam do desfile de 7 de setembro em Brasília
item.description: Representatives from the three branches of government, including President Lula, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin, took part in the September 7th parade in Brasília. The event, which lasted approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes, gathered thousands of people at the Esplanade of the Ministries and featured performances such as the human pyramid and the Brazilian Air Force demonstration.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) e Lula (45%) mantêm empate técnico no 2º turno
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Lula (PT) remain technically tied in the second round, with 46% and 45% of voting intentions, respectively, according to a BTG/Nexus survey released on August 8, 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Nexus indica freio no avanço meteórico de Cury
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll published on April 8 shows a decline in Augusto Cury's (Avante) voting intentions, dropping from 8% in the spontaneous poll to 6%. In the stimulated poll, his numbers also likely experienced adjustments, interrupting the meteoric rise previously observed.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula tem compromissos no Planalto e Zema vai a reunião com emissoras
item.description: On Tuesday, the presidential candidates follow different schedules: Lula holds institutional commitments at the Planalto, while Zema attends a meeting with broadcasters in Brasília. Flávio Bolsonaro has no public agenda.
